chapterInfo.content:
4
Ofieahwɛfoɔ pa wɔ Onyankopɔn adom mu
1Na afei, sɛ Kristo ahunu amane honam mu yi, mo nso momfa adwenkorɔ no ara mmia mo ho, (ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wahunu honam mu amaneɛ no agyae bɔneyɛ,) 2na honam mu asetena berɛ a aka no, wantena ase amma nnipa akɔnnɔ bio, na mmom watena ase ama Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ. 3#Efe 2.2-3; Tito 3.3 Yɛn asetena berɛ a atwa mu no, yɛsɛe berɛ yɛɛ deɛ amanaman mufoɔ no pɛ, sɛ yɛnantee ahohwie, akɔnnɔ, nsaborɔ, agobɔne, didimeeɛ ne abosonsom a wɔkyire mu. 4Na ɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa sɛ afei mo ne wɔn ntu mmirika nkɔ saa sakasaka pɔtɔɔ no mu, na wɔka mo ho nsɛmmɔne. 5#2 Ti 4.1 Wɔn na wɔbɛyi ano akyerɛ deɛ wasiesie ne ho sɛ ɔrebɛbu ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ atɛn no. 6#1 Pe 3.19 Na yei nti na wɔkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ awufoɔ nso, na wɔabu wɔn atɛn sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ honam mu, na wɔatena ase wɔ honhom mu sɛ Onyankopɔn.
7 # 1 Ko 10.11; 1 Yoh 2.18 Nanso adeɛ nyinaa awieeɛ abɛn. Enti momma mo adwene mu nte na mo ani nna hɔ mma mpaebɔ. 8#Mmb 10.12; Yak 5.20 Na ne titire no, momfa ɔdɔ a emu yɛ den nnodɔ mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔ kata bɔne pii so. 9#Heb 13.2 Monyegye mo ho ahɔhoɔ a anwiinwii biara nni mu. 10Sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa nyinyaa adom akyɛdeɛ no, momfa nsom mo ho mo ho sɛ Nyankopɔn adom ahodoɔ no ho fieahwɛfoɔ pa. 11#Rom 12.7 Sɛ obi ka asɛm a, ma no nka no sɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm. Sɛ obi som a, ma no nsom sɛ ɛfiri ahoɔden a Onyankopɔn de ma mu, na wɔnam Yesu Kristo so ahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, ade nyinaa mu. Ɔno na animuonyam ne tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen.
Amaneɛ a Kristo nti wɔhunu
12 # 1 Pe 1.6-7 Adɔfo, mommma amanehunu gya a asɔ wɔ mo mu sɛ wɔde resɔ mo ahwɛ no nnyɛ mo sɛ ade foforɔ, te sɛ ade foforɔ bi na ɛreyɛ mo; 13#Rom 8.17; Aso 5.41; Yak 1.2 na mmom, sɛdeɛ moayɛ Kristo amanehunu no fafafoɔ no, momma mo ani nnye, na sɛ wɔyi n’animuonyam no adi a, mode ahosan ama mo ani agye nso. 14#1 Pe 2.20 Sɛ wɔya mo Kristo din nti a, nhyira ne mo, ɛfiri sɛ animuonyam ne Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ mo so. 15Na mommma mo mu bi nnhunu amane sɛ owudifoɔ anaa owifoɔ anaa ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ anaa ɔsɛmpɛfoɔ ebinom nsɛm mu. 16#Flp 1.20 Na sɛ ɔhunu amane sɛ okristoni a, ɔmmma n’ani nnwu, na ma no nhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ din yi mu.
17 # Hes 9.6; Yer 25.29 Na ɛberɛ no aduru sɛ atemmuo firi aseɛ Nyankopɔn fie. Na sɛ ɛfiri yɛn so kane a, ɛbɛwie wɔn a wɔntie Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no sɛn? 18#Mmb 11.31; Luk 23.31 Na
sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛgye onipa tenenee a,
ɛhe na deɛ ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn ne ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ bɛgyina?
19 # Dwom 31.5 Enti nso wɔn a wɔhunu amaneɛ sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ no mfa wɔn kra nhyɛ ne nsa, sɛ Ɔbɔadeɛ nokwafoɔ, na wɔnkɔ so ara wɔ papayɛ mu.

Na afei, sɛ Kristo ahunu amane honam mu yi, mo nso momfa adwenkorɔ no ara mmia mo ho, (ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wahunu honam mu amaneɛ no agyae bɔneyɛ,) na honam mu asetena berɛ a aka no, wantena ase amma nnipa akɔnnɔ bio, na mmom watena ase ama Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ. Yɛn asetena berɛ a atwa mu no, yɛsɛe berɛ yɛɛ deɛ amanaman mufoɔ no pɛ, sɛ yɛnantee ahohwie, akɔnnɔ, nsaborɔ, agobɔne, didimeeɛ ne abosonsom a wɔkyire mu. Na ɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa sɛ afei mo ne wɔn ntu mmirika nkɔ saa sakasaka pɔtɔɔ no mu, na wɔka mo ho nsɛmmɔne. Wɔn na wɔbɛyi ano akyerɛ deɛ wasiesie ne ho sɛ ɔrebɛbu ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ atɛn no. Na yei nti na wɔkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ awufoɔ nso, na wɔabu wɔn atɛn sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ honam mu, na wɔatena ase wɔ honhom mu sɛ Onyankopɔn.
Nanso adeɛ nyinaa awieeɛ abɛn. Enti momma mo adwene mu nte na mo ani nna hɔ mma mpaebɔ. Na ne titire no, momfa ɔdɔ a emu yɛ den nnodɔ mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔ kata bɔne pii so. Monyegye mo ho ahɔhoɔ a anwiinwii biara nni mu. Sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa nyinyaa adom akyɛdeɛ no, momfa nsom mo ho mo ho sɛ Nyankopɔn adom ahodoɔ no ho fieahwɛfoɔ pa. Sɛ obi ka asɛm a, ma no nka no sɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm. Sɛ obi som a, ma no nsom sɛ ɛfiri ahoɔden a Onyankopɔn de ma mu, na wɔnam Yesu Kristo so ahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, ade nyinaa mu. Ɔno na animuonyam ne tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen.

Adɔfo, mommma amanehunu gya a asɔ wɔ mo mu sɛ wɔde resɔ mo ahwɛ no nnyɛ mo sɛ ade foforɔ, te sɛ ade foforɔ bi na ɛreyɛ mo; na mmom, sɛdeɛ moayɛ Kristo amanehunu no fafafoɔ no, momma mo ani nnye, na sɛ wɔyi n’animuonyam no adi a, mode ahosan ama mo ani agye nso. Sɛ wɔya mo Kristo din nti a, nhyira ne mo, ɛfiri sɛ animuonyam ne Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ mo so. Na mommma mo mu bi nnhunu amane sɛ owudifoɔ anaa owifoɔ anaa ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ anaa ɔsɛmpɛfoɔ ebinom nsɛm mu. Na sɛ ɔhunu amane sɛ okristoni a, ɔmmma n’ani nnwu, na ma no nhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ din yi mu.
Na ɛberɛ no aduru sɛ atemmuo firi aseɛ Nyankopɔn fie. Na sɛ ɛfiri yɛn so kane a, ɛbɛwie wɔn a wɔntie Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no sɛn? Na
sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛgye onipa tenenee a,
ɛhe na deɛ ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn ne ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ bɛgyina?
Enti nso wɔn a wɔhunu amaneɛ sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ no mfa wɔn kra nhyɛ ne nsa, sɛ Ɔbɔadeɛ nokwafoɔ, na wɔnkɔ so ara wɔ papayɛ mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
